name: rigorgraph
description: Verification-first research workflows and auditable claim-evidence graphs for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: Audit claims, evidence, and research releases.
interface.longDescription: Capture research claims, attach scoped evidence, run independent verification, and audit releases without treating model consensus or numerical scans as proof.
defaultPrompt: Structure my research question without overstating evidence.
Capture this claim and its supporting evidence.
Audit this RigorGraph project before release.
